_about: Declared regenerable files the Google Drive archives leave out (lead and supervisor, 18 November 2026; EVIDENCE-BACKUP-A keeps the evidence and records). Read at call time by tools/loop/drive_archive.py (gather) and tools/loop/backup_coverage.py (a matched file is excluded, not a gap). A rule has an id, a reason, and either a glob over the logical path or min_bytes with min_links.
_why: external/s05/DEV_contradoc15 measured 334988500552 bytes on 18 November because each of its 15 admitted bundles holds assets.tar, one 20.72 GiB file hard-linked 15 times (21.4 GiB unique in the whole part). assets.tar is the sealed asset bundle (model weights and adapter) the sealer builds again from the frozen model store; it is not evidence.

rules.reason: the sealed asset bundle, rebuilt by the sealer from the frozen model store
a file of 1 GiB or more with more than one hard link is a copy of a frozen store file

_not_parts: Files that belong to no part at all, read at call time by tools/loop/backup_coverage.py: never listed, stat'ed or hashed (the lead, 18 November 2026 16:30, after the 16:22 coverage run failed on a lock file that vanished between listing and hashing). A rule has an id, a glob over the logical path (private/ is docs/loop/private) and a reason.

not_parts.reason: a lock a running tool holds for seconds and removes (budget_ledger.jsonl.lock); it records nothing
